messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — noticed account/org metadata bleed in console previews when rapidly switching workspaces. Screenshot in thread. :eyes:
Maria: repro steps?
Alex: Steps: open org A, open run preview, quickly switch to org B via quick-switch, preview panel still shows A's orgName/orgId for ~1s. Happened twice during demo.
Kevin: Yikes. Can reproduce locally with 3 tabs. Looks like prefetch cache not keyed by workspace header. :bug:
Alex: Stack trace from console:
```
GET /internal/preview?runId=xyz
Response: { runId: 'xyz', orgId: 'org-A', previewHtml: '...' }
Cache key: /internal/preview?runId=xyz
```
Maria: Internal API (preview-service) uses request path only as cache key; we forgot to include X-Workspace header in cache key.
Liz: Also telemetry shows metric preview_cache_hits without workspace tag, so our rollouts/A/B telemetry could be mixing orgs.
Sam: Short-term fix: patch cache key generation to include workspace header and add a fallback TTL of 50ms to reduce visible stale windows. Rollout plan: canary to 5% on hosted, then 25%.
Jordan: Adding tests: integration test that simulates rapid org switch and asserts no cross-org ids. Also add unit test for cache key function.
Kevin: Who owns preview-service? @Liz? @Maria? Need a PR by EOD for the hotfix.
Liz: I can own the PR and coordinate canary. Will also add kibana query to find impacted customer IDs and alert support.
Alex: Thanks. @ops-bot can we tag infra to bump canary to 5% during lunch? :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Scheduled canary deploy 5% for preview-service at 12:30 UTC. Incident channel notified.
Maria: Follow-ups: add workspace tag to preview telemetry, update run-level logs to scrub orgId except for authorized flows, and create roll-forward plan in case of regressions.
Alex: Great. I'll DM @support with affected org list and do a postmortem doc draft.
